releaseName: Agent setup and advanced topics in the user guide, and a fallback critic
summary: The user guide, in Help and on the public guide pages, gains Advanced sections: how to connect an agent and what each agent permission allows, how a draft is written and checked, private sections and screening, what the data download holds, and how to run DraftLoop on your own computer. Settings > Agents now links its setup guide there instead of the repository. A run whose critic fails can switch once to a fallback critic the deployment names, and Run details shows the switch, with a warning when the fallback comes from the author's company. The Keycloak image is rebuilt on a patched Java runtime. The operator can open a run's trace from its feedback note, and each run logs its active time when its draft is ready.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. Deleting an account from the screen works only for a person alone in their organisation; a team owner asks an operator. The readable copy does not yet include the career interview or research briefs.
